title: Phase-1 provisional canonical claim record (v1)
description: PROVISIONAL Phase-1 contract pulled forward from Phase 4. This schema is NOT the formal Phase-4 claim contract. It is superseded by unit ARC-0085 (Contract: Claim record schema with duplicate, support and contradiction edges). Do not treat this as frozen formalization.

schema_version.description: Provisional v1. ARC-0085 may bump when formalizing.

schema_status.description: Must remain PROVISIONAL until ARC-0085 formalizes the Phase-4 contract.

superseded_by_unit.description: Phase-4 unit that supersedes this provisional contract.

canonical_mechanism.description: Canonical mechanism statement for the claim.

duplicate_of.description: Edges to claims this record is a duplicate of (claim ids).

supports.description: Support edges to other claim ids.

contradicts.description: Contradiction edges to other claim ids.

source_lineage.description: Source lineage entries (path/URL, probe, optional digest).

confidence.description: Sherman-Kent-style band from the declared vocabulary, or null when not rated.

implementation_impact.description: Decision/implementation impact of treating this claim as true.

settling_probe.description: EXACT settling probe. Mandatory for every provisional claim record.

claim_text.description: Optional human-readable claim statement when distinct from canonical_mechanism.

legacy_fields.description: Complete copy of any pre-provisional record fields so migration has zero field loss.
